standardRoom.name: Standard Room
standardRoom.description: Comfortable and cozy, ideal for solo travelers or couples.
standardRoom.fullDescription: Our standard room offers the perfect balance of comfort and value. With partial sea views, this room includes all essential amenities for a relaxing stay. The modern and functional design ensures you have everything you need for a restful sleep.

deluxeSuite.name: Deluxe Suite
deluxeSuite.description: Spacious and luxurious, with a separate living area and panoramic views.
deluxeSuite.fullDescription: The Deluxe Suite redefines the concept of luxury and comfort. With a separate living area, this suite offers the perfect space to relax and enjoy panoramic views of the natural landscape. Every detail has been carefully selected to provide a unique and unforgettable experience.

privatePoolVilla.name: Private Pool Villa
privatePoolVilla.description: Maximum privacy and exclusivity with a private pool and terrace.
privatePoolVilla.fullDescription: Experience absolute luxury in our Private Pool Villa. This sanctuary of tranquility offers complete privacy with its own pool and exclusive terrace. Enjoy first-class services including butler service and romantic dinners, all while admiring breathtaking views from your own personal paradise.

familySuite.name: Family Suite
familySuite.description: Spacious and comfortable, designed for families who want to share special moments.
familySuite.fullDescription: Our Family Suite has been specially designed with families' needs in mind. With two connecting rooms and a dedicated play area, this suite offers the perfect space for everyone to enjoy a memorable vacation. Amenities include TVs in each room and a family-sized refrigerator for added convenience.
